harsh-sunlight.name: Harsh Sunlight
harsh-sunlight.desc:
Boosts the damage dealt by Fire-type moves
by 50% and halves the damage dealt by
Water-type moves.

rain.name: Rain
rain.desc:
Boosts the damage dealt by Water-type moves
by 50% and halves the damage dealt by
Fire-type moves.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.desc:
Pokémon that are not Rock, Ground, or Steel
types take damage equal to 1/16 of their max
HP at the end of every turn. Boosts the Sp. Def
stats of Rock-type Pokémon by 50%.

snow.name: Snow
snow.desc:
Boosts the Defense stats of Ice-type Pokémon by
50%.

electric-terrain.name: Electric Terrain
electric-terrain.desc:
Pokémon on the ground have the power of their
Electric-type moves boosted by 30% and they
cannot fall asleep.

grassy-terrain.name: Grassy Terrain
grassy-terrain.desc:
Pokémon on the ground have the power of their
Grass-type moves boosted by 30% and they
have 1/16 of their max HP restored at the end
of every turn.

misty-terrain.name: Misty Terrain
misty-terrain.desc:
Halves the damage dealt by Dragon-type moves
used against Pokémon on the ground. Pokémon
on the ground are also immune to status
conditions and cannot become confused.

trick-room.name: Trick Room
trick-room.desc: Pokémon with lower Speed stats move first.

magic-room.name: Magic Room
magic-room.desc: Most held items do not work.

wonder-room.name: Wonder Room
wonder-room.desc:
Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats
are swapped.

critical-hit-ratio-boost.name: Critical-Hit Ratio Boost
critical-hit-ratio-boost.desc:
The Pokémon's attacks are more likely to be
critical hits.

confused.name: Confused
confused.desc:
For 1–4 turns, the Pokémon has a 1-in-3 chance
of hurting itself.

infatuated.name: Infatuated
infatuated.desc:
The Pokémon has a 50% chance of being unable
to use its moves while the Pokémon that gave it
the Infatuated status is on the field.

drowsy.name: Drowsy
drowsy.desc:
The Pokémon will fall asleep at the end of the
next turn after becoming drowsy.

no-ability.name: No Ability
no-ability.desc: The Pokémon's Ability loses its effect.

unable-to-repeat.name: Unable to Repeat
unable-to-repeat.desc:
The Pokémon cannot use the same move twice
in a row.

cant-escape.name: Can't Escape
cant-escape.desc:
The Pokémon cannot be switched out of battle.
Ghost-type Pokémon are unaffected.

locked-on.name: Locked On
locked-on.desc:
On the next turn after gaining the Locked On
status, the Pokémon's move will not miss if
targeting the Pokémon that was locked onto.

electric-boost.name: Electric Boost
electric-boost.desc:
The power of the next Electric-type move used
by the Pokémon will be doubled.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.desc:
Boosts the accuracy of moves by 67%. Pokémon
such as Flying types or ones with the Levitate
Ability become grounded. Moves that involve
flying or leaping cannot be used.

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.desc:
The Pokémon is immune to status conditions and
cannot become confused.

stealth-rock.name: Stealth Rock
stealth-rock.desc:
Pokémon that switch into battle will take damage
equal to 1/8 of their max HP. This damage differs
depending on the Pokémon's type matchup with
the Rock type.

stockpiling.name: Stockpiling
stockpiling.desc:
The Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are
boosted by 1 stage for each time it has used
Stockpile.

taunted.name: Taunted
taunted.desc: The Pokémon can use only attacks.

magnet-rise.name: Magnet Rise
magnet-rise.desc:
The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it
immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the
Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses.

toxic-spikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxic-spikes.desc:
Pokémon that switch into battle will be poisoned
or, if 2 layers of Toxic Spikes are set, badly
poisoned. Pokémon such as Flying types or ones
with the Levitate Ability are unaffected. This status
is removed if a Poison-type Pokémon enters battle.

wish.name: Wish
wish.desc:
At the end of the next turn after the Wish status
is activated, the HP of the Pokémon in the
affected spot will be restored by 1/2 of the max
HP of the Pokémon that caused the status.

sticky-web.name: Sticky Web
sticky-web.desc:
Pokémon that switch into battle will have their
Speed stats lowered by 1 stage. Pokémon such as
Flying types or ones with the Levitate Ability
are unaffected.

ingrained.name: Ingrained
ingrained.desc:
The Pokémon has 1/16 of its max HP restored at
the end of every turn. It also becomes grounded
and cannot be switched out of battle.

cursed.name: Cursed
cursed.desc:
The Pokémon loses 1/4 of its max HP at the end
of every turn.

trick-or-treating.name: Trick-or-Treating
trick-or-treating.desc: The Pokémon gains the Ghost type.

light-screen.name: Light Screen
light-screen.desc:
Halves the damage taken from special moves.
In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by
1/3 instead.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.desc:
Halves the damage taken from physical moves.
In Double Battles, this damage is reduced by
1/3 instead.

sealing-off.name: Sealing Off
sealing-off.desc:
Any moves known by the Pokémon that caused
this status cannot be used by its opponents.

perishing.name: Perishing
perishing.desc:
The Pokémon will faint 3 turns after gaining the
Perishing status.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.desc:
Pokémon that switch into battle will take damage
equal to 1/8 of their max HP. This damage will
increase if 2 layers of Spikes are set, and again
if 3 layers are set. Pokémon such as Flying types
or ones with the Levitate Ability are unaffected.

destiny-bound.name: Destiny Bound
destiny-bound.desc:
If the Pokémon is knocked out by an opponent,
that opponent will also be knocked out.

forest-cursed.name: Forest Cursed
forest-cursed.desc: The Pokémon gains the Grass type.

leech-seeded.name: Leech Seeded
leech-seeded.desc:
The Pokémon takes damage equal to 1/8 of its
max HP at the end of every turn. The Pokémon in
the spot of the Pokémon that caused the Leech
Seeded status has its HP restored by the same
amount. Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected.

bound.name: Bound
bound.desc:
For 4–5 turns, the Pokémon takes damage equal
to 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn. It
cannot be switched out of battle.

rampaging.name: Rampaging
rampaging.desc:
For 2–3 turns, the Pokémon continues its attack
and is unable to take any other actions. After
that, it becomes confused.

badly-poisoned.name: Badly Poisoned
badly-poisoned.desc:
The Pokémon takes increasing poison damage
at the end of every turn, starting at 1/16 of the
Pokémon's max HP, then 2/16, then 3/16, and
so on. If the Pokémon switches out and reenters
battle, the damage restarts at 1/16 of its max HP.

future-attack.name: Future Attack
future-attack.desc:
The Pokémon in the targeted spot will take
damage 2 turns after the Future Attack status
is activated.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.desc:
For 3 turns, the Pokémon continues its attack and
is unable to take any other actions. During this
time, no Pokémon on the field can fall asleep.

aqua-ring.name: Aqua Ring
aqua-ring.desc:
The Pokémon has 1/16 of its max HP restored at
the end of every turn.

landed.name: Landed
landed.desc:
The Pokémon is now grounded and can be
affected by Ground-type moves.

fairy-locked.name: Fairy Locked
fairy-locked.desc:
No Pokémon on the field can be switched out
of battle until the end of the next turn after the
Fairy Locked status is activated.

psychic-terrain.name: Psychic Terrain
psychic-terrain.desc:
Pokémon on the ground have the power of their
Psychic-type moves boosted by 30% and they
are immune to priority moves.

throat-chopped.name: Throat Chopped
throat-chopped.desc:
The Pokémon cannot use any sound-based moves
for 2 turns.

aurora-veil.name: Aurora Veil
aurora-veil.desc:
Halves the damage taken from physical and
special moves. In Double Battles, this damage
is reduced by 1/3 instead.

octolocked.name: Octolocked
octolocked.desc:
The Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are
lowered by 1 stage at the end of every turn.

salt-cured.name: Salt Cured
salt-cured.desc:
The Pokémon takes damage equal to 1/16 of its
max HP at the end of every turn. If the Pokémon
is a Steel type or Water type, it takes damage
equal to 1/8 of its max HP instead.

syrupy.name: Syrupy
syrupy.desc:
The Pokémon's Speed stat is lowered by 1 stage
at the end of every turn.

healing-prevented.name: Healing Prevented
healing-prevented.desc:
The Pokémon is unable to restore HP through
moves, Abilities, or held items.

wide-open.name: Wide Open
wide-open.desc:
Opponents' moves will not miss the Pokémon
and will deal double damage.

recharging.name: Recharging
recharging.desc: The Pokémon cannot take any actions for 1 turn.

charging.name: Charging
charging.desc:
The Pokémon spends 1 turn charging before
using a move.

sky-high.name: Sky-High
sky-high.desc:
The Pokémon cannot be hit by most moves,
excluding moves such as Thunder, Hurricane,
and Smack Down. The Pokémon is also
unaffected by the terrain.

submerged.name: Submerged
submerged.desc:
The Pokémon cannot be hit by most moves, but
Surf and Whirlpool will hit and will deal double
damage. The Pokémon is also unaffected by
the terrain.

underground.name: Underground
underground.desc:
The Pokémon cannot be hit by most moves, but
Earthquake will hit and will deal double damage.
The Pokémon is also unaffected by the terrain.

concealed.name: Concealed
concealed.desc:
The Pokémon cannot be hit by moves and is
unaffected by the terrain.

minimized.name: Minimized
minimized.desc:
Moves such as Supercell Slam, Body Slam,
Dragon Rush, Flying Press, Heat Crash, and
Heavy Slam will not miss the Pokémon and
will deal double damage.

atk-def-swapped.name: Atk/Def Swapped
atk-def-swapped.desc:
The Pokémon's Attack and Defense stats
are swapped.

flash-fire.name: Flash Fire
flash-fire.desc:
Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type
moves by 50%.

jaw-locked.name: Jaw Locked
jaw-locked.desc:
Neither the Pokémon that caused the Jaw Locked
status nor the Pokémon on the receiving end can
be switched out of battle.

micle-berry.name: Micle Berry
micle-berry.desc:
Boosts the accuracy of the Pokémon's next move
by 20%.
